title: SkillsPublish
description: supabase/functions/skills-publish/index.ts. Authenticated. The client submits a full SKILL.md-format markdown document (frontmatter + body). The function's frontmatter parser deliberately mirrors MiraSkillLoader's client-side parser line-for-line, per its own header comment, so the same file validates identically on both sides — a Windows client's own parser must match this same grammar (--- key: value pairs --- then the body) rather than reimplementing it independently. Runs a Claude Haiku moderation pass server-side before inserting the row; the client never sees or influences the moderation prompt.

markdown.description: Full SKILL.md content: a --- frontmatter block (must include at least `name:`, kebab-case, ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{1,60}$) followed by a closing --- and then the body (min 10 chars after trimming). Recognized frontmatter keys: name (required, becomes slug), title (becomes display name, falls back to slug), tagline/description (becomes tagline, truncated to 120 chars, tagline takes precedence if both present), category (one of Productivity/Engineering/Communication/Creative, defaults to Productivity if absent/invalid), icon (defaults to "sparkles").

status.title: SkillsPublishStatus
status.description: approved = AI moderation verdict "approve", auto-listed immediately. rejected = verdict "reject". pending = verdict "review" (ambiguous, awaits human review) OR the ANTHROPIC_API_KEY secret was unset server-side (moderation unavailable falls back to pending, not a hard error).

reason.description: One-sentence moderation rationale from the Claude moderation call, truncated to 300 chars. "moderation could not be completed" if the moderation call itself failed.

detail.description: Present alongside malformed_skill, invalid_name, slug_taken, insert_failed — a human-readable elaboration.
